## free-tier-llm-landscape
- What matters: Free-tier rate limits, available models, and terms at Groq, Together, OpenRouter, Google Gemini, and Hugging Face can change without notice; I have no web access and am unsure of current specifics.
- Why it matters to this system: An agent relying only on free tiers can break or stall if a model is removed, throttled, or reclassified.
- Worth verifying: Current limits, model names, and terms for each provider before relying on them in production.

## agent-safety-practice
- What matters: Good practice uses tiered approvals for risky actions, sandboxing with least-privilege access, treating external content as untrusted to resist prompt injection, and immutable audit logs.
- Why it matters to this system: Autonomous coding agents can execute code and modify files, so guardrails limit damage from mistakes or malicious instructions.
- Worth verifying: That approvals, sandbox boundaries, and log retention are actually enforced and reviewed, not just documented.
